Hints: The x-value is the first coordinate
Solution: The ordered pair gives x first and y second. The x-axis is hours studied, so the first value4 represents4 hours studied.

Question Choices: Fill: A scatter plot shows shoe size on the x-axis and height on the y-axis. If a point is $(8, 148)$, what does 148 represent?
Solution: The second coordinate is the y-value. The y-axis is labelled height, so148 is the recorded height. Axis position alone does not establish a causal dependency.

Hints: Look at the direction of the values over time
Solution: The recorded value falls from38 to15, a change of-23. Since it falls as time advances, the trend is decreasing.

Question Choices: Fill: A regression line is $y = 3x + 4$. Estimate $y$ when $x = 5$.
Solution: Substitute x=5 into the fitted model: predicted y=3(5)+(4)=15+(4)=19. This is a model prediction; an actual observation may differ.

Question Choices: Fill: Every student in a class survey chooses exactly one of cats or dogs. If 14 prefer cats and 21 prefer dogs, how many students were surveyed?
Solution: The two mutually exclusive categories include every surveyed student. Total=14+21=35.
